why: I checked each expect line against the must_not item, which forbids an expect line that can only be checked on the published page or after merge. The first five lines (the --shout runs, the plain greeting, the no-name usage case and npm test) can all be checked at the pull request's head. The sixth line breaks the rule: "After merge, the published docs page at https://o.github.io/greet-cli/ lists --shout." Its proof is "open https://o.github.io/greet-cli/", so it can only be checked on the live site after merge. The output's own assumptions say so: "The live site can only be checked after merge." A line that checks docs/index.md at the PR head would have worked instead.
